packageRules.description: A PostgreSQL major upgrade needs a dump/restore migration in the module; never propose it as a tag bump
The reusable workflows are pinned to commits of the v1 branch, which Renovate looks up as a tag and cannot resolve; they are updated by hand
Group minor and patch UI updates into one PR; each image change needs one CATALOG_VERSION bump
